question: Find the first name and gender of student who have more than one pet.
classification_result:
Reason: The query requires joining Student and Has_Pet to count pets per student, then filtering students with more than one pet. No nested subquery is required.
Label: NON-NESTED
Sub_questions: []
generated_sql:
SELECT Student.Fname, Student.Sex
FROM Student
JOIN Has_Pet ON Student.StuID = Has_Pet.StuID
GROUP BY Student.StuID, Student.Fname, Student.Sex
HAVING COUNT(Has_Pet.PetID) > 1;
